title: Spa Managers
description: Plan, direct, or coordinate activities of a spa facility. Coordinate programs, schedule and direct staff, and oversee financial activities.

tasks.text: Respond to customer inquiries or complaints.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Complaint resolution needs authority and rapport

dwas.name: Resolve customer complaints or problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Perform accounting duties, such as recording daily cash flow, preparing bank deposits, or generating financial statements.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain financial records; human reconciles exceptions

tasks.text: Coordinate facility schedules to maximize usage and efficiency.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI optimizes schedules; human handles exceptions

tasks.text: Assess employee performance and suggest ways to improve work.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Performance review aided; accountability and context human

dwas.name: Evaluate employee performance.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Monitor operations to ensure compliance with applicable health, safety, or hygiene standards.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI flags quality/safety issues; human owns physical verification

tasks.text: Verify staff credentials, such as educational and certification requirements.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Credential verification via databases, human handles exceptions

tasks.text: Check spa equipment to ensure proper functioning.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Hands-on verification of equipment functioning

dwas.name: Inspect equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Establish spa budgets and financial goals.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Budget management aided by AI, human owns decisions

dwas.name: Manage budgets for personal services operations.

tasks.text: Recruit, interview, or hire employees.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Broad HR work needs human judgment and accountability

tasks.text: Develop staff service or retail goals and guide staff in goal achievement.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Service plans drafted; operational ownership human

dwas.name: Develop plans for programs or services.

tasks.text: Maintain client databases.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Maintain client records; human owns sensitive judgment

dwas.name: Maintain client information or service records.

tasks.text: Schedule staff or supervise scheduling.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Assignments drafted; accountability and negotiation human

dwas.name: Assign duties or work schedules to employees.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Inventory products and order new supplies.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

tasks.text: Inform staff of job responsibilities, performance expectations, client service standards, or corporate policies and guidelines.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Service staff coaching is interpersonal and situational

tasks.text: Train staff in the use or sale of products, programs, or activities.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Service staff coaching is interpersonal and situational

tasks.text: Schedule guest appointments.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Calendar scheduling automatable; exceptions need human judgment

tasks.text: Sell products, services, or memberships.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Closing sales requires persuasion and accountability

tasks.text: Develop or implement marketing strategies.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Service plans drafted; operational ownership human

dwas.name: Develop plans for programs or services.

tasks.text: Plan or direct spa services and programs.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Service plans drafted; operational ownership human

dwas.name: Develop plans for programs or services.

tasks.text: Direct facility maintenance or repair.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Facility maintenance direction requires hands-on site oversight

dwas.name: Direct facility maintenance or repair activities.

tasks.text: Participate in continuing education classes to maintain current knowledge of industry.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI supports study; certification requires human
